title: 第7章 抢女主机缘第8章 师尊让你给我当狗
slug: 穿成女配弹幕让我又争又抢
content_zh:
谢长歌微微蹙眉，没理袁松亭，转头对季月道：“季师妹，你暂无灵力护身，你就别去了。”
季月一双美眸转而扫过谢长歌身后的人，落在袁松亭身上，“谢师兄不必担心我，我有的是钱，我愿意出五十两，不知你们其中谁愿意陪我去临县？”
多少？五十两！
普通百姓一月工钱才二三两，若无一技之长，都不到二两。
“我！”
“我我我！季师姐！”
“还有我！我愿意！”
师弟们争先恐后的举起手，嫌弃的把袁松亭挤到了后边，他不愿意，就别挡道！
季月记得嚼舌根那几人的声音，故意在准备挑他们时又摇头瞧向其他人，专挑养眼的师弟。
手也没闲着，从空间摸出银两提前给他们，师弟们见此更兴奋了，一口一个多谢季师姐。
至于季月的钱是哪来的，当然是祝徵的！
袁松亭目光直勾勾盯着宛若散财童子的季月，她白嫩纤细的手一看就是金尊玉贵养出来的。
当下这双手正不停地给人银子，好多个五十两在他眼前飞出去，他有些动摇，他家境并不富裕，举一村之力才托举他到天山宗。
他太想要了，就在他抬起手时，季月嘴角噙笑的道：
“好了，就你们五个，你们的任务就是保护我的安全，还有协助谢师弟除妖。”
袁松亭感觉自己有点裂了，死手为什么早不举！
季月没错过他脸上一闪而过的悔意，心情顿时爽起来。
【骂我是给：爽！】
【无能的丈夫：送出啤酒x20。】
【建材美妇王阿姨：送出小心心x20。】

【骂我是给：送出小心心x20。】
见过跑车，季月对小礼物波动不大，她真的只是觉得跑车特效好看而已！
她意念回复观众们：“谢谢各位的打赏。”
谢长歌方才不建议季月去，是怕临县作祟的是大妖，他分不出心来保护她，现在有五个人跟着，他就放心了。
临县。
季月他们一路过来，城中都是静悄悄的，仿佛是一座死城，连个人问点消息都找不到。
好在谢长歌他们可以御剑飞行，在天上一看就知道问题出在哪。
以城西为中心的山林向周围扩散百里内，土地皆是荒芜一片。
“这地方我有点印象，是个乱葬岗，百年前还有位县太爷因贪污受贿被赐死，子女入狱无人操持后事，被远方亲戚拖到这埋的。”
师弟甲说道。
师弟乙点点头：“此地阴气环绕，煞气极重，看看状况应该是出旱魃了。”
季月不禁看向师弟乙，小子有点东西，一语道破。
直播间的观众为季月解惑道：【天山宗是此间世界第一大宗，宗门内都是天骄，没有废物，当然除了你。】
季月：……。
谢长歌腰间的长剑出鞘，安排道：“三人和我去杀旱魃，剩下的人保护季师妹。”
师弟甲和师弟乙留了下来，谢长歌和另外三人往山林飞去。
不出片刻，林间刀光剑影，打斗声传出。
content_en:
Xie Changge frowned slightly, ignored Yuan Songting, turned to Ji Yue and said, "Junior sister Ji, you don't have the spiritual power to protect yourself yet, so don't go."
Ji Yue's beautiful eyes glanced at the person behind Xie Changge and landed on Yuan Songting, "Brother Xie, don't worry about me. I have plenty of money. I am willing to pay fifty taels. I wonder which of you is willing to accompany me to Linxian?"
How much? Fifty taels!
Ordinary people only earn 2 or 3 taels per month. If they don't have any skills, it will be less than 2 taels.
"Me!"
"Me me me! Senior Sister Ji!"
"And me! I do!"
The juniors rushed to raise their hands and pushed Yuan Songting to the back in disgust. If he didn't want to, just stay out of the way!
Ji Yue remembered the voices of those people who were chewing the tongue, and when she was about to pick them, she deliberately shook her head and looked at the others, specifically picking out the eye-catching junior brother.
His hands were not idle, he took out silver coins from the space and gave them to them in advance. Seeing this, the junior brothers became even more excited and thanked Senior Sister Ji one by one.
As for where Ji Yue's money came from, of course it came from Zhu Zheng!
Yuan Songting stared straight at Ji Yue, who looked like a child who had scattered wealth. Her white, tender and slender hands looked like they were raised by gold and jade.
At the moment, these hands were constantly giving money to people, and many fifty taels flew out in front of his eyes. He was a little shaken. His family was not rich, and it took a village to support him to the Tianshan Sect.
He wanted it so much. Just when he raised his hand, Ji Yue said with a smile:
"Okay, it's just the five of you. Your mission is to protect my safety and help Junior Brother Xie eliminate the demon."
Yuan Songting felt like he was a little cracked. Why didn't he raise his dead hand earlier?
Ji Yue didn't miss the flash of regret on his face, and her mood suddenly brightened.
[Swearing at me means: It’s cool! 】
[Incompetent Husband: Give away beer x20. 】
[Auntie Wang, the beautiful lady of building materials: Send a little heart x20. 】
[Calling me for giving: Give me a little heart x20. 】
Having seen a sports car, Ji Yue didn't have much interest in the small gifts. She really just thought the special effects of the sports car were good-looking!
She mentally replied to the audience: "Thank you for your tips."
Xie Changge didn't suggest Ji Yue go just now because he was afraid that it was a big demon who was causing trouble in Lin County and he wouldn't be able to protect her. Now that there are five people following him, he feels relieved.
Lin County.
When Ji Yue and the others arrived, the city was quiet, as if it was a dead city. They couldn't even find anyone to ask for information.
Fortunately, Xie Changge and the others could fly with swords, and they would know what the problem was when they saw it in the sky.
The mountain forest centered on the west of the city spreads to the surrounding area within a hundred miles, and the land is completely barren.
"I have some impressions of this place. It is a mass grave. A hundred years ago, a county magistrate was sentenced to death for taking bribes. His children were imprisoned and had no one to take care of their affairs. They were dragged and buried here by distant relatives."
Junior Brother A said.
Junior Brother B nodded: "This place is surrounded by Yin Qi, and the evil Qi is extremely strong. Judging from the situation, there should be a drought demon."
Ji Yue couldn't help but look at Junior Brother B. The boy had something and he made it clear.
The audience in the live broadcast room explained Ji Yue's doubts: [The Tianshan Sect is the largest sect in the world. There are all geniuses in the sect, and there is no waste, except of course you. 】
Ji Yue:…….
Xie Changge unsheathed the long sword at his waist and made arrangements: "The three of you and I will kill Han Bao, and the rest will protect Junior Sister Ji."
Junior Brother A and Junior Brother B stayed behind, while Xie Changge and the other three flew to the mountains and forests.
Within a moment, the lights of swords and the sounds of fighting could be heard in the forest.
